feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 31 May 2026 4:34pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 31 May 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

A complex area of low pressure in the Atlantic driving associated fronts across the area tonight.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 overnight. Increasing 5, occasionally 6 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then occasional rain or drizzle arriving overnight. Areas of mist and isolated fog patches developing later.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor later and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 to 6 veering west or southwest 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle as well as areas of mist and isolated fog patches. This all gradually clearing eastwards overnight into Tuesday leaving a few showers.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, very poor in fog patches. Gradually becoming good, but moderate in showers.
